title: neotorularia grubovii
intro: Neotorularia grubovii, commonly known as Chinese tansy, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Neotorularia grubovii include its use as a treatment for fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Neotorularia grubovii, including sesquiterpenoids, are responsible for its pharmacological properties, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
